Science and sources

The sources

The physics, injury criteria and test set-ups follow published research, standards and crash-test protocols: 78 references, each checked against the original. The equations cite them by these numbers.

Every entry was checked against the original publication, standard or protocol. Numbers match the citations in Equations and sources.

Credits

  • Lexus RX 350: "Lexus RX 350 + rigged (+ rigged driver (human))" by menarzuw, CC BY 4.0.
  • Ford Mustang GT500: "Ford Mustang Gt 500 With pro Rig FOR FREE!" by NoOb StUfFs, CC BY 4.0.

Both models are split into parts, re-oriented, scaled and simplified for this app.

Race textures and sky: from Poly Haven, CC0: asphalt_02, concrete_floor_02 and red_brick_03 by Rob Tuytel; concrete_pavement and concrete_tile_facade by Charlotte Baglioni; beige_wall_001 by Dimitrios Savva and Rico Cilliers; the wide_street_01 HDRI by Sergej Majboroda.

Hurricane Brawl's Earth: coastlines, lakes, populated places and country figures from Natural Earth (public domain), through its GitHub mirror nvkelso/natural-earth-vector.

Libraries:

  • three.js (MIT), loaded from jsDelivr;
  • mp4-muxer (MIT), loaded from jsDelivr when a video is first saved;
  • the Draco decoder (Apache 2.0);
  • the simplex noise in the crumple shader, after Ashima Arts and Stefan Gustavson (MIT).

The methods, standards and test protocols behind the models are listed under References; the equations are under Equations and sources.
